deviations.baseline_behavior: Background jobs start a separate pwsh process and parallel tasks use runspaces created from the session; policy inheritance is not enforced in the code read.
deviations.proposed_behavior: Child processes and parallel runspaces inherit policy, language mode and visibility as a hard rule, with per-job quotas.
deviations.benefit: Prevents escape from a restricted session through jobs.
deviations.compatibility_cost: Jobs cannot be more privileged than the parent.

deviations.baseline_behavior: ThrottlingJob, ContainerParentJob and a job source-adapter registry exist.
deviations.proposed_behavior: One local job type plus the parallel pool.

deviations.baseline_behavior: Debugger enable/attach is not a distinct audited privilege.
deviations.proposed_behavior: Policy-controlled, audited debugger attach; prompt runs at the lowest trust level on the stack.

deviations.baseline_behavior: Nested debugging of jobs and remote runspaces exists.
deviations.compatibility_cost: No job or remote debugging initially.

deviations.baseline_behavior: Received-event and action queues are unbounded.
deviations.proposed_behavior: Bounded queues with policy-defined drop rules.
deviations.compatibility_cost: Events may be dropped under load.

deviations.baseline_behavior: Forwarded events and WMI/CIM event sources are supported.
